name: Artifact

props.name: src
props.description: URL the preview iframe frames.

props.name: files
props.type: undefined | { path: string; url?: undefined | string; code?: undefined | string; language?: undefined | string; type?: undefined | "html" | "pdf" | "image" | "other"; additions?: undefined | number; deletions?: undefined | number; status?: undefined | "added" | "modified" | "deleted" | "renamed" | "untracked" }[]
props.displayType: undefined | { path: string; url?: undefined | string; code?: undefined | string; language?: undefined | string; type?: undefined | "html" | "pdf" | "image" | "other"; additions?: undefined | number; deletions?: undefined | number; status?: undefined | "added" | "modified" | "deleted" | "renamed" | "untracked" }[]
props.description: Files for the Code tab's tree (+ each file's preview `url`).

props.name: tab
props.description: Controlled active tab — when set, the artifact follows it (re-asserted on every change). When undefined the tab is uncontrolled (see `defaultTab`).

props.name: defaultTab
props.description: Uncontrolled INITIAL tab (used only when `tab` is undefined). The user can then freely switch tabs; defaults to `preview`.

props.name: activeFile
props.description: Selected file path (syncs tree highlight + Code source + preview).

props.name: sandbox
props.description: iframe `sandbox` override. Default `allow-scripts allow-forms`.

props.name: iframeTitle
props.description: Accessible iframe title.

props.name: maximized
props.description: Controlled maximize view-state (drives the expand/restore button).

props.name: showNav
props.description: Show the back/forward nav buttons. Default `true`.

props.name: showReload
props.description: Show the reload button. Default `true`.

props.name: showHome
props.description: Show the home button. Default `true`.

props.name: showPathField
props.description: Show the editable path/address field. Default `true`.

props.name: showTabs
props.description: Show the Preview|Code tab toggle. Default `true`.

props.name: expandable
props.description: Show the expand-to-fill button. Default `false` (opt-in).

props.name: openInTab
props.description: Show the open-in-new-tab button. Default `false` (opt-in).

props.name: standalone
props.description: Standalone chrome: rounded + bordered (default in-panel = square, borderless).

props.name: readonlyPath
props.description: Make the path field read-only (visible, nav-tracking, non-editable).

props.name: displayUrl
props.description: Friendly address shown in the path field INSTEAD of the real current url (read-only, non-navigable). Use when the framed url is not consumer-facing (e.g. a `data:` blob) so a clean address is shown instead of leaking it. Unset = show the real url (editable per `readonlyPath`).

callbacks.name: onNavigate
callbacks.description: Fired when the preview navigates (back/forward/reload/path-edit/file-click).

callbacks.name: onTabChange
callbacks.description: Fired when the Preview|Code tab changes.

callbacks.name: onFileSelect
callbacks.description: Fired when a file is selected in the tree.

callbacks.name: onMaximizeChange
callbacks.description: Fired when the expand/restore button toggles the maximize view-state.

callbacks.name: controllerRef
callbacks.description: Receive the imperative controller once mounted. The `<kai-artifact>` facade forwards these as element methods (back/forward/reload/home/navigate/ selectFile/openExternal/maximize/restore).

description: `Artifact` — a framed, switchable generated-artifact viewer. A functional nav toolbar (back · forward · reload · home + editable path field + Preview|Code toggle) over a sandboxed `<iframe>` (Preview) or a file-tree + `<kai-code-block>` (Code). The component self-navigates the iframe and emits `kai-navigate` / `kai-tab-change` / `kai-file-select` so a consumer can observe/sync.

name: Card

props.name: heading
props.description: Heading rendered in the card chrome (the contract's CardEnvelope.title). NB: NOT `title` — `title` is a reserved IDL attr (see define.tsx RESERVED).

props.name: description
props.description: Optional supporting text under the heading.

props.name: errorMessage
props.description: When set, the card renders its standard inline error state INSTEAD of body.

props.name: dense
props.description: Compact spacing for dense lists of cards.

props.name: headingId
props.description: Stable id for the heading (so composing cards can `aria-labelledby` it). Auto-generated when omitted.

props.name: dismissible
props.description: Render a dismiss (×) button that hides the card and calls `onDismiss`. Opt-in, OFF by default — the contract cards never set it, so they are unaffected.

props.name: href
props.description: Render the whole card as a link (`<a>`). Wins over `clickable`.

props.name: target
props.description: `target` for the `href` anchor.

props.name: rel
props.description: `rel` for the `href` anchor (default `noopener noreferrer` when `target="_blank"`).

props.name: clickable
props.description: Make the whole card behave like a button: `role="button"`, a tabindex, and Enter/Space activation, firing `onCardClick`. Ignored when `href` is set. A clickable/href card must NOT also contain footer action buttons — that nests interactive elements. Use `actions` OR clickable, never both.

description: `Card` — the shared presentational chrome every native card composes from: an optional media region, a heading + description, a body (default slot), an actions footer, and one consistent inline **error** state (the contract's "never a broken/partial card" rule). It is intentionally chrome-only: it reads no `CardContext` and emits no `CardEvent` — the cards that compose it (e.g. `kai-form`) own the contract interaction. The optional `dismissible` / `href` / `clickable` behaviors are all OFF by default, so the contract cards (which set none of them) keep their original presentational behavior unchanged. a11y: a `clickable` or `href` card MUST NOT also contain footer action buttons — that nests interactive controls inside a button/link. Use `actions` OR make the card clickable, never both.

description: `ChoiceCard` — a single-select "pick one of N rich options" card (plans, products, flights, quick replies) inside `Card` chrome. The options are a WAI-ARIA radiogroup (list rows) with roving tabindex: clicking a row (or Space/Enter on the focused row) **selects** it locally without emitting; a **Submit** button below the list then emits the Card contract's **`action`** verb (`{ kind:'action', cardId, action: option.id, payload }`) and resolves the card (chosen option shown read-only) so the same pick can't double-fire. An optional `allowOther` free-text escape appends a selectable "Other…" row; selecting it reveals an inline text input, and the same Submit emits `action:'__other__'` with `{ text }`. Emits `ready` on mount and `error` for an unusable definition (inline error state).

description: `Embed` — a privacy-first lazy media facade. Initial render is a poster + a play button: NO provider iframe, NO provider JS, NO cookies until the user opts in. On play it swaps in the provider `<iframe>` (youtube-nocookie / vimeo dnt / allowlisted generic). description: The shared message body: the message's `parts` rendered in a single ordered pass (text, reasoning, tool calls, generative-UI cards, and file attachments interleaved exactly as they appear), followed by the action bar. This is the single source of truth for how a message renders, consumed by `ChatThread` (the `<For>` over `messages`), the standalone `<kai-message>` facade, and (in future) `kai-compare` for each candidate. Pure/prop-driven: all interaction state (copied, feedback vote) is owned above and passed in.

description: `ResponseCompare` — a dual-response comparison. Two assistant candidates for the same prompt render side-by-side (or as tabs), each via `MessageBody` so a candidate reads exactly like an assistant message (reasoning + tools + attachments + markdown). The pick is a COMMIT, not a Submit: clicking "Pick this" (or Enter on the focused column) computes `{ chosenId, rejectedIds:[other], at }`, optimistically collapses to the chosen candidate's body, and calls `onSelect` for the consumer to send a `(prompt, chosen, rejected)` preference pair. Single-shot. While EITHER candidate is `streaming`, both pick controls are disabled and the streaming column shows a `TextShimmer`; `onReady` fires once both settle. The two columns are a WAI-ARIA radiogroup with roving tabindex (Arrow keys move A↔B, Enter/Space picks). Emits `onError` for a malformed definition.

name: Resizable

props.name: handle
props.description: Divider affordance on each interactive handle: `line` (default), `grip`, or `none`.

props.name: maximizedIndex
props.description: Which panel index is maximized (null = none). Hides the others.

callbacks.name: onChange
callbacks.description: Fired on drag-end / keyboard resize / visibility change with the current panel sizes (percent).

callbacks.name: onMaximizeChange
callbacks.description: Fired when the maximized panel changes (index, or null on restore).

description: Convenience group that takes `ResizablePanel` children and AUTO-INSERTS a `ResizableHandle` between each pair of visible (non-`hidden`) panels. A handle is interactive only between two unlocked neighbors; otherwise it renders as a static divider. Power users who need manual control can keep using `ResizablePanelGroup` + explicit `ResizableHandle`s.

props.name: handle
props.description: Divider affordance drawn inside the 8px grab zone: - `line` (default) — a 1px hairline, transparent at rest, tinting on hover/drag. - `grip` — a dotted grip handle. - `none` — no visible divider (invisible hit-area only).

props.name: keyboardStep
props.description: Keyboard nudge step in pixels (default 16). Home/End jump to min/max.

props.name: static
props.description: Render as a static, non-interactive divider (e.g. between locked panels).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Explicit axis; overrides `ResizableContext`. Needed by facades that render handles outside a context provider (e.g. `<kai-resizable>`).

props.name: defaultSize
props.description: Initial main-axis size: number/`"25%"` (percent) or `"280px"` (pixels). Omitted → flexible.

props.name: minSize
props.description: Minimum size during resize (px or %).

props.name: maxSize
props.description: Maximum size during resize (px or %).

props.name: locked
props.description: When true, the panel's size is fixed and adjacent handles are non-draggable.

props.name: hidden
props.description: When true, the panel is not visible (used by the `Resizable` convenience to drop dividers).

props.name: orientation
props.description: Which axis scrolls. `vertical` (default) · `horizontal` · `both`. The cross axis is clamped to `hidden` so content can't overflow it.

props.name: variant
props.description: Shape preset. `text` = one or more lines; `rect` = a block; `circle` = round. Omit for the bare, class-driven block (size it with utility classes yourself — the original low-level usage).

props.name: width
props.description: CSS width (a number is treated as px). With a `variant` and no width it fills its container (responsive); for `circle` it is the diameter.

props.name: height
props.description: CSS height (a number is treated as px). Defaults per variant.

props.name: lines
props.description: `text` only: how many lines to render (the last is shorter). Default 1.

props.name: closeDelay
props.description: Delay (ms) before it hides after the pointer leaves. Defaults to 0 (hides immediately).

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement (post flip/shift). Defaults to `'top'`.

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: Initial open state on mount (uncontrolled seed).

props.name: disabled
props.description: When true, hover/focus (and `show()`) never opens the tooltip.

callbacks.name: controllerRef
callbacks.description: Receive the open controller (open accessor + setOpen) once mounted.
